name: MindDoc
one_liner: Daily mood and symptom check-ins with periodic summaries to share with a clinician, plus CBT-based courses; free with a paid Plus tier.
best_for: Tracking depression or anxiety symptoms between appointments
People who want structured self-guided CBT courses
Bringing a clear symptom history to a doctor or therapist
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want to talk to a therapist in the app
People who don't want their app use tracked across other companies' apps
short_description: A self-help app that asks short daily questions about mood and symptoms, gives periodic summaries, and offers CBT-based courses.
long_description: MindDoc, from MindDoc Health GmbH in Germany, asks you short questions several times a day about your mood and symptoms and turns them into regular summaries you can take to a doctor or therapist. It also includes journaling and a library of courses based on cognitive behavioral therapy covering depression, anxiety, sleep and more. Tracking is free; MindDoc Plus unlocks more features, with App Store prices including $69.99 for 12 months. A 2023 randomized controlled trial of the app with 1,045 adults with mild to moderate symptoms found a small improvement in self-management skills and symptom burden at 8 weeks compared with care as usual. The App Store listing says identifiers and usage data may be used to track you across other companies' apps.
patient_summary: You answer a few quick questions about your mood each day, and every couple of weeks you get a summary you can share with a clinician. CBT-based courses help you work on depression, anxiety and sleep. Tracking is free; MindDoc Plus costs $69.99 a year on the App Store, with shorter plans available.

pricing.notes: App Store in-app purchases also list 3-month ($29.99) and 6-month ($44.99) plans and monthly options; the listing doesn't say exactly which features need Plus.

privacy.notes: The App Store listing says identifiers and usage data are used to track you across other companies' apps; we could not open the full privacy policy to check deletion terms.

seo.title: MindDoc: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: MindDoc tracks your mood and symptoms over time and offers CBT-based courses, with regular check-in reports you can share with a clinician.

faqs.a: Free; MindDoc Plus about $69.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with MindDoc before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can MindDoc replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. MindDoc is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
MindDoc is available on iPhone and Android.
Daily mood and symptom questions; Periodic emotional health reports; CBT-based course library; Exportable assessments.

clinical_trials.study: Randomized controlled trial of the MindDoc app versus care as usual

citation.title: Effects of a Self-Guided Transdiagnostic Smartphone App on Patient Empowerment and Mental Health: Randomized Controlled Trial

clinical_trials.outcome: Self-management skills improved more than care as usual at 8 weeks (d = 0.29); symptom burden (d = 0.28) and quality of life also improved.
clinical_trials.study_design: Randomized controlled trial (care as usual / delayed access control)

CBT-based courses on depression, anxiety and sleep
